# Spec: stage-roles
<!-- Generated by /hef.spec -->
<!-- Date: 2026-09-30 -->

## Overview

Board items HEF-11 and HEF-12 (report 18 addendum A2/A3/A5). The launcher knows two roles, `implement`
and `verify`, so the by-stage pane layout has nothing to launch for the Plan & Design and Deploy stages
and every blocked line looks the same to every pane. This feature adds two roles — **`plan`** (a fresh
process that takes a board item through `/hef.spec` → `/hef.plan` → `/hef.review` (the fresh-context
reviewer) → `/hef.tasks` on the item's worktree, writes only under `.specify/`, and exits on the first
clarification it cannot decide) and **`deploy`** (HEF-7's babysitter as a headless role, one process
per pass, `/hef.babysit <n> --once`) — a `--stage plan|build|deploy` switch on `/hef.orchestrate`
(default `build`, so today's call is unchanged), a matching `--stage` filter on `ledger.sh next`, per-stage
tiers and tool allowlists, and **pane-aware block routing**: `orchestrate.panes` maps block kinds to pane
names and the session-start line names the owner pane on every blocked entry.

Decisions taken here rather than left as clarifications: the plan worker runs in the item's worktree
(`-w <id>`, reused later by `implement`) and **commits** its `.specify/` artifacts there, so the build
stage finds them; the plan worker runs `/hef.review` plan mode itself (7.4.0 made that a fresh
`code-reviewer`, not a person) and blocks on `human:plan-review` only when the reviewer says
`NEEDS_DISCUSSION` or asks for a second revision; the deploy worker runs while the entry is blocked on
`human:merge` (that block *is* the wait it babysits), so `next --stage deploy` admits it; the launcher
does every ledger write from the worker's structured output (a worker's sandbox root is its worktree, the
ledger is in the common dir), which is why the babysitter's own `ledger-id` exit 1 is tolerated headless;
every role's allowlist gets the plugin's own helper directory (`Bash(<plugin hooks dir>/*>`) appended
**unconditionally** — the path is machine-specific and cannot live in the tracked config, and without it a
launched session cannot run a single `hef.*` pre-flight, a gap present since 7.3.0 and surfaced by adding
roles whose whole job is running those commands; no role's list admits `gh pr merge`, `gh pr review` or
`gh api` (the babysitter's `gh` calls all live inside `pr-watch.sh`, which the hooks rule covers); the plan
worker runs in `--permission-mode default`, not `acceptEdits`, because `acceptEdits` auto-approves every
edit in the worktree and would make `Edit(.specify/**)` decorative — under `--permission-prompts none` an
edit outside the pattern is denied instead; a `closed` PR leaves the deploy set through `human:intake`;
attempts keep counting `implement` claims only (a plan retry after a clarification is not a stall).
Plan review 2026-09-30 (fresh context) changed five of these lines; see `plan.md`.

## User Scenarios

### US1: A queued item is planned by a fresh session and lands in `tasks` [P1]
- **Given** a registered, unblocked entry in phase `queued` and `/hef.orchestrate --stage plan`
- **When** the launcher starts `session-launch.sh plan <id>`
- **Then** a `claude -p` runs in the item's worktree with the sanitised item as data, edits allowed only
  under `.specify/`, the plugin's helpers callable, tier `orchestrate.tiers.plan` (default `opus`); on
  outcome `tasks` the ledger records worktree, branch and an absolute `spec_dir` and advances to `tasks`
- **Edge**: outcome `blocked` with `human:clarify` (a marker the worker could not decide) or
  `human:plan-review` (the reviewer returned `NEEDS_DISCUSSION`) → the entry is blocked on that kind,
  `spec_dir` recorded so `unblock` can check the artifact
- **Error**: outcome `failed` → non-zero, phase stays `intake`, and `next --stage plan` picks it again (a
  second launch resumes from the `spec_dir` it recorded, never re-specs); the same resume applies after a
  person clears `human:clarify` or `human:plan-review`

### US2: The build stage continues from a planned item [P1]
- **Given** an entry in phase `tasks` with `spec_dir` recorded
- **When** `/hef.orchestrate` (stage `build`) runs `ledger next --stage build` and launches `implement`
- **Then** the worker's prompt says the spec, plan and tasks exist at `spec_dir` and names
  `/hef.implement` (or `hefesto:workflow`) → `/hef.verify` → `/hef.quality` → `/hef.review` → `/hef.pr`,
  the existing worktree is reused, and the phase moves `tasks → implement`
- **Edge**: a `queued` entry (no plan stage) is still dispatched through `/hef.agent` as today
- **Error**: `next --stage build` finds nothing → non-zero naming the stage

### US3: The deploy stage babysits a PR headless [P1]
- **Given** an entry in phase `pr` with `pr.url` and a worktree recorded, blocked on `human:merge` or unblocked
- **When** `/hef.orchestrate --stage deploy` runs `ledger next --stage deploy` and `session-launch.sh deploy <id>`
- **Then** a `claude -p` runs in the worktree with `/hef.babysit <number> --once --max-fixes <n>`, tier
  `orchestrate.tiers.deploy` (default `opus`), and the launcher transcribes the structured result:
  `mergeable` → blocked on `human:merge` (kept if already set); `conflict` → `conflict`; `questions > 0` →
  `human:intake`; `checks` with `fixes ≥ max` → `ci`; `review`/`pending` → no block, re-run later
- **Edge**: the entry has no `pr.url` → the launcher refuses before any run
- **Error**: no structured output → non-zero with stdout/stderr excerpts, as today

### US4: Every pane sees whose block it is [P1]
- **Given** entries blocked on `human:merge` and `human:clarify` and no `orchestrate.panes` config
- **When** any session starts in the checkout
- **Then** the lines read `ledger: HEF-7 blocked_on human:merge since … → deploy pane — …` and
  `… human:clarify … → plan pane — …` from the built-in default map
- **Edge**: `orchestrate.panes` in `.claude/project-status.json` maps `human:merge` to `release` → the
  line says `→ release pane`; a kind no map names → `→ orchestrator pane`
- **Error**: an unreadable config → the default map, never a missing line

### US5: The dry run shows each stage's exact line [P2]
- **Given** `--dry-run`
- **When** `session-launch.sh plan|deploy <id> --dry-run` runs
- **Then** the copy-pasteable `claude -p` line is printed with `--name plan-<id>` / `deploy-<id>`, the
  stage's tier and allowlist, and nothing is claimed
- **Edge**: `/hef.orchestrate --stage plan --dry-run` prints the plan line for the next queued entry
- **Error**: an unknown stage → usage, exit 2

## Functional Requirements

| ID | Requirement | Priority | Scenario |
|----|-------------|----------|----------|
| FR-001 | `ledger.sh next [--stage plan\|build\|deploy]`: `plan` → unowned, unblocked, phase `queued` or `intake`; `build` (default) → unowned, unblocked, phase `queued`, `tasks` or `implement`; `deploy` → unowned, phase `pr`, `pr.url` set, `blocked_on` null or kind `human:merge`, ordered unblocked first then by the oldest last `deploy` run (an entry never babysat sorts first), so one PR parked at the gate never monopolises the stage; unknown stage → usage (2); nothing → non-zero naming the stage | P1 | US1, US2, US3 |
| FR-002 | `session-launch.sh` accepts roles `plan` and `deploy` beside `implement` and `verify`; tiers `orchestrate.tiers.plan` / `.deploy` (default `opus`) through the same `rank()` guard (tiers only, never a model id); allowlists `orchestrate.allowed_tools.plan` / `.deploy` with the defaults below | P1 | US1, US3 |
| FR-003 | `Bash(<launcher's hooks dir>/*)` is appended to every role's allowlist **after** the config or default list (`(config // default) + [rule]`), so a launched session can always run the plugin's own helpers (`speckit-helper.sh`, `pr-watch.sh`, `status-board.sh`, `ledger.sh`) and a project's own `allowed_tools.<role>` (which should carry its test command — this repository: `Bash(bash tests/smoke.sh*)`) cannot drop it; no role's default list contains `gh pr merge`, `gh pr review` or `gh api` — the structural form of "never merges", asserted by the smoke suite | P1 | US1, US3 |
| FR-004 | `plan` role: `-w <id>` (worktree reused when present), **`--permission-mode default`** (never `acceptEdits`: it auto-approves every edit in the worktree and would make the path rule decorative; under `--permission-prompts none` an edit outside the rule is denied), default tools `Read, Glob, Grep, Skill, Agent, Edit(.specify/**), Bash(git *)` (+ the hooks rule; `Edit(pattern)` covers Write and MultiEdit); the prompt carries the sanitised item as data and the chain `/hef.spec` → `/hef.plan` → `/hef.review` (plan mode) → `/hef.tasks` → commit under `.specify/`, or — when the entry already has `spec_dir` (a retry, or a cleared block) — the **phase-aware resume**: "the spec exists there; do not re-spec; run `/hef.clarify` only while `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]` markers remain, `/hef.plan` only if `plan.md` is missing, `/hef.review` (plan mode) only if `plan.md` lacks `## Reviewed`, then `/hef.tasks`" (a cleared `human:plan-review` block means `## Reviewed` is already there — re-planning would erase it and a second review would fall into code mode); stop rules: first undecidable `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION]` → outcome `blocked`/`human:clarify`; reviewer `NEEDS_DISCUSSION` or a second `REVISE_PLAN` → `blocked`/`human:plan-review`; hostile item text → `blocked` with `blocked_on` null (→ `human:intake`); schema `{summary ≤2000, outcome: tasks\|blocked\|failed, spec_dir, blocked_on: human:clarify\|human:plan-review\|null}` | P1 | US1 |
| FR-005 | `plan` transcription: claim with role `plan` (attempts unchanged); `queued → intake` at start (an `intake` entry stays); on `tasks`: `record --worktree --branch --spec-dir <absolute> --route full` (so the verify chain includes `/hef.verify`) then `advance tasks`; on `blocked`: record what is known (`spec_dir` when reported), `block --kind <k or human:intake>`; on `failed`: record what is known, non-zero, phase stays `intake` — re-dispatchable by `next --stage plan` | P1 | US1 |
| FR-006 | `implement` role: `next --stage build` admits phase `tasks`; when the entry has `spec_dir`, the prompt states that the spec, plan and tasks exist there and names `/hef.implement` (or `hefesto:workflow`) → `/hef.verify` → `/hef.quality` → `/hef.review` → `/hef.pr` instead of `/hef.agent`; `tasks → implement` at start (as `queued → implement` today) | P1 | US2 |
| FR-007 | `deploy` role: refuses without `pr.url` or a recorded worktree; cwd = worktree, no `-w`; `--permission-mode acceptEdits` (the fix step edits inside the PR's diff — `in-diff` and the armed test guard are the boundary there); default tools `Read, Glob, Grep, Skill, Agent, Edit, Write, Bash(git *), Bash(gh auth status)` (+ the hooks rule — every other `gh` call the babysitter makes lives inside `pr-watch.sh`; a project adds its test command through `allowed_tools.deploy`); prompt `/hef.babysit <number> --once --max-fixes <orchestrate.max_fixes // 3>` with the headless rule (no questions can be asked; report doubtful items; the ledger is written by the launcher, so a `ledger-id`/`ledger.sh` failure inside is reported, not retried; a pre-flight refusal by `pr-watch.sh resolve` is verdict `refused` with the helper's line in the summary); schema `{summary ≤2000, verdict: mergeable\|conflict\|checks\|review\|pending\|closed\|refused, fixes: int, questions: int}` | P1 | US3 |
| FR-008 | `deploy` transcription: claim role `deploy`; `run` recorded; `questions > 0` → `block --kind human:intake`; else `mergeable` → `block --kind human:merge` unless already that kind (`since` untouched); `conflict` → `block --kind conflict`; `checks` with `fixes ≥ max_fixes` → `block --kind ci`; `closed` → `block --kind human:intake` (a closed, unmerged PR leaves the deploy set for a person); `review`, `pending`, `checks` under the bound, `refused` → no block change; the final entry printed | P1 | US3 |
| FR-009 | `/hef.orchestrate [--stage plan\|build\|deploy] [--dry-run]`: default `build`; the launcher receives only `--dry-run` when present, never `$ARGUMENTS` verbatim (it would reject `--stage`); the frontmatter `argument-hint` names both flags; step 3 uses `next --stage <s>`; steps 1 and 4 (register, read as data) run for `plan` and `build`, not `deploy`; step 5 launches `plan`, or `implement` then `verify`, or `deploy` — each launch is one Bash call made with the tool timeout raised to 600000 ms (a deploy pass blocks up to 540 s in the babysitter's CI wait; an implement run is longer still); the brief names the stage | P1 | US1, US2, US3, US5 |
| FR-010 | `session-start-context.sh`: every blocked line carries the owner pane — `ledger: <id> blocked_on <kind> since <t> → <pane> pane — …` — from `orchestrate.panes` in `<cwd>/.claude/project-status.json` when present and well-formed (an object of pane → array of kinds; a config pane replaces that pane's default list, other panes keep theirs), else the built-in map `orchestrator: human:intake · plan: human:clarify, human:plan-review · build: verdict, stall, budget, conflict · deploy: ci, human:merge`; a kind no map names → `orchestrator`; a malformed map (`panes` that is not an object — a string, number or array — or a pane value that is not an array, or invalid JSON) → the default map, never a missing line; when two panes name one kind, the config's pane wins | P1 | US4 |
| FR-011 | `--dry-run` for `plan` and `deploy` prints the line (`--name plan-<id>` / `deploy-<id>`, the role's `--model`, `--allowedTools`) and claims nothing; an unknown role → usage (2) | P2 | US5 |
| FR-012 | Docs: `.specify/specs/session-orchestration/spec.md` FR-015 (the blocked-line format now carries the pane), `docs/commands.md` (`--stage`), `docs/hooks.md` (four roles; owner pane on the session-start line; `next --stage`), `docs/install.md` §7 (stage runs; `allowed_tools.<role>` should carry the project's test command; the launch calls need the raised tool timeout), README §5 by-stage cells name the real commands, `CHANGELOG.md` `[Unreleased]` — stating explicitly that the `implement` and `verify` allowlists of every existing install now gain the hooks rule; board HEF-11 and HEF-12 → `tasks/DOING.md`; counts unchanged (no new command, no new hook) | P2 | US1 |

## Success Criteria

| ID | Criterion | Validation Method |
|----|-----------|-------------------|
| SC-001 | Fake-`claude` run path for `plan` (outcome `tasks` → phase `tasks`, absolute `spec_dir`, worktree/branch recorded, `--name plan-<id>`, `Edit(.specify/**)` and `Bash(<hooks>/*)` in `--allowedTools`, `--permission-mode default` and no `acceptEdits`; outcome `blocked` → `human:clarify`, then `unblock` + `next --stage plan` returns it; `failed` → non-zero, phase `intake`, a second launch proceeds with the phase-aware resume prompt — argv carries "only if plan.md lacks") and `deploy` (fixture entry in `pr` with `pr.url` + worktree; `mergeable` → `human:merge` with `since` unchanged when already set; `conflict` → `conflict`; `questions` → `human:intake`; `checks` + fixes = max → `ci`; `closed` → `human:intake`; `pending`/`refused` → unchanged; refused without `pr.url`; no `-w`; no `gh pr merge`/`gh pr review`/`gh api` in any role's default list); `implement` on a `tasks` entry: prompt names `/hef.implement` and `spec_dir`, phase `implement`; `next --stage` for all three including the deploy ordering; the hooks rule present with a config override in place. Mutations: plan filter (`intake` dropped), `pr.url` refusal, `-ge` → `-gt`, tasks-phase prompt conditional, mergeable-already-set, hooks-rule append, no-merge-verbs list, `acceptEdits` on the plan role, deploy questions branch, deploy ordering | `tests/smoke.sh` |
| SC-002 | Session-start blocked lines carry `→ deploy pane` / `→ plan pane` by default, `→ release pane` under a config override, the config's pane when it re-homes a default kind, and the default pane under a malformed map — a pane value that is not an array, AND `panes` itself a string; mutations (default map emptied; the object guard weakened back to `select`) red | `tests/smoke.sh` |
| SC-003 | `/hef.orchestrate --stage plan --dry-run` and `--stage deploy --dry-run` on this repository print the stage's launch line (user-run from an unsandboxed pane; the launcher refuses `--dry-run` under the sandbox by design) | user-run |
| SC-004 | `bash tests/smoke.sh` green; existing orchestration cases unchanged (the default stage is `build`) | CI |
